question.plainText: ![Pulley system]https://cracku.in/media/uploads/image_VFI4e0y.png Two blocks are suspended from a pulley Two blocks of masses 2text{ kg} and 1text{ kg} respectively, are tied to the ends of a string which passes over a light frictionless pulley as shown in the figure below. The masses are held at rest at the same horizontal level and then released. The distance traversed by the centre of mass in 2text{ s} is _______ m. Take g = 10text{ m/s}^2

explanation.latex:
Let $m_1 = 2\text{ kg}$ and $m_2 = 1\text{ kg}$. The acceleration of the blocks is given by $a = \frac{m_1 - m_2}{m_1 + m_2}g = \frac{2 - 1}{2 + 1} \times 10 = \frac{10}{3}\text{ m/s}^2$.
The $2\text{ kg}$ block accelerates downwards (let's call this negative), and the $1\text{ kg}$ block accelerates upwards.
The acceleration of the centre of mass is $a_{com} = \frac{m_1(-a) + m_2(a)}{m_1 + m_2} = \frac{2(-10/3) + 1(10/3)}{3} = \frac{-10/3}{3} = -\frac{10}{9}\text{ m/s}^2$.
The magnitude of acceleration of the COM is $10/9\text{ m/s}^2$.
The distance traversed by the COM from rest in $t = 2\text{ s}$ is $S = \frac{1}{2} |a_{com}| t^2 = \frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{10}{9}\right) (2)^2 = \frac{20}{9} \approx 2.22\text{ m}$.

The acceleration of the centre of mass is a_{com} = (m_1(-a) + m_2(a)/m_1 + m_2) = (2(-10/3) + 1(10/3)/3) = (-10/3/3) = -(10/9)text{ m/s}².
The magnitude of acceleration of the COM is 10/9text{ m/s}².
The distance traversed by the COM from rest in t = 2text{ s} is S = (1/2) |a_{com}| t² = (1/2) left((10/9)right) (2)² = (20/9) approx 2.22text{ m}.
